reuse.why: All providers share the new link guard and reuse findOrCreateBank and syncAccount, but Fintegra copies existing linking and download workflows and replacement copies unlink cleanup.

duplication.why: The change adds three substantial duplicated blocks: provider linking orchestration, transaction downloading, and local unlink field clearing.

placement.why: Provider integration follows the existing module boundaries, although a function named assertBankAccountNotLinked now also performs destructive link replacement.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the four requested changes, including the type-driven client updates and release notes.

maintainability.why: Centralized link rules help maintenance, but copied provider workflows and a validation helper that also mutates accounts make future changes harder to reason about.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked duplicates unlinkAccount's local cleanup instead of extracting a shared local unlink operation that both replacement and ordinary unlinking can use.

disguised_duplication.where: The Fintegra linking and download functions and replacement cleanup are straightforward copies rather than duplication concealed through restructuring.

abstraction_drift.where: The shared link assertion gains replaceExistingLink and branches for target lookup, closed-target rejection, replacement permission, replacement-target lookup, and missing-target rejection; it also takes on unlink mutations, while all six linking handlers call it.
